description: This Java source file defines a BackupAgentHelper subclass named FileHelperExampleAgent used in an Android application to handle backup and restore of specific app data files using the Android backup framework. It installs a FileBackupHelper for a data file and overrides backup and restore methods to include locking for thread safety.

classes.name: FileHelperExampleAgent
classes.description: A BackupAgentHelper subclass that manages backup and restore of app data files with integrated locking to ensure thread safety during data operations.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the backup helper by adding a FileBackupHelper for the application's data file.

methods.name: onBackup
methods.description: Overrides the backup routine to include locking around the call to the superclass method, ensuring thread-safe backup operations.

methods.name: onRestore
methods.description: Overrides the restore routine to include locking around the superclass method, ensuring thread-safe restore operations.
